blurb: Sunshine Coast Air offers year-round daily scheduled float plane flights connecting the Sunshine Coast to Vancouver Airport, Victoria Airport, and Nanaimo Harbour. They also provide charter services with a fleet of de Havilland Beaver and Cessna 180 seaplanes accessing waterfront destinations. Scenic tours range from 30–50-minute flights over coastlines, rapids, and glaciers to longer half-day trips to waterfalls and remote restaurants.
